deliverable: Deliverable 7 — STRIDE Threat Model and On-Chain Monitoring Plan

criteria.text: A versioned public data-flow model identifies actors, stores, sensitive flows, custody, dependencies, trust boundaries, and current testnet addresses.
A public STRIDE register covers all six categories with IDs, severity, affected components, treatment, and residual-risk decisions.
Each threat maps to a tested monitor or documented off-chain control with baseline, trigger, address, and owner.
A published drill report demonstrates notification, escalation, guarded pause handling, evidence capture, and monitor updates after address changes.
